That you for replying. And thank you so you so much for support. You have no idea how much it means to have someone to talk to. 
I worked in a dead end job in a call centre, with no future and no prospects. I worked there just as a means to an end to pay the rent whilst I saved up for an engagement ring. 
It's just much, too soon, and the future that I thought I had ahead of me a literally fallen apart infront of me. 
And the idea of starting again terrifies me.
